findings.summary: Sandbox._decode turns a non-UTF-8 filename into a U+FFFD path. The per-file `git diff -- <path>` then matches nothing and exits 0, so the entry is sent as a complete `patch: ""` with non-zero additions and no patch_truncated flag, and scan_diff sees nothing.
findings.action: In build_structured_diff, when stat.path contains U+FFFD, skip the exec and emit patch="" with patch_truncated=True. Document it next to the .gitattributes gap and add a test that builds the path via `git update-index --cacheinfo`.

findings.summary: rules.py _iter_added_lines uses splitlines(), which also breaks on \x0b, \x0c, \x1c-\x1e, \x85, \u2028 and \u2029, so parts of such lines go unscanned and later line numbers shift.
findings.action: Track as a scanner follow-up; rules.py is frozen for this task.
